title: Club management – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Club management through complete workflows
hero.lead: Process requests, records, organisation, fees, banking, documents and reports from start to completion.

body:
Select the club, read the overview and open the correct workspace

Select the club before any change, export or financial operation. The overview shows current states and open work and links to Requests, People, Organisation, Finance, Bank & SEPA, Documents, Reports and Setup. Global search finds members, numbers, accounts, receivables and documents. Read, edit, approval, banking, document and export permissions are separate; unavailable actions may therefore be hidden.

Process membership, change and link requests

Separate open and completed requests, search, filter status and sort by age. For membership requests, review person, address, requested date, language, consents, representation, evidence and fee preview. Ask a question when information is unclear, then accept or reject with a reason; only acceptance creates a member record.

For change requests, compare old and requested values, ask questions and apply or reject deliberately. For account links, verify member, recipient, relation and validity, then approve, reject or cancel an unclaimed invitation. Conversation and history remain with the request.

Create, find and maintain complete member records

Search by name or member number and filter current, former or all memberships. Creating a member records number, join date, personal data, contact and address.

The record separates Overview; Contact & access including households, portal, user, player and coach links; Club membership including departments, offices, committees, qualifications and honours; Fees & payments; and History & notes including status, resignation, consents, privacy and merging. Change status with effective date and reason; resignation is a separate workflow. User accounts, memberships and sport profiles remain distinct linked records. Review both records before merging.

Import member data and resolve quality findings

Select or create a mapping profile, upload the file, map every source column and set a default payment method if needed. Review normalised values, required-field errors, departments and identity candidates row by row. Decide Create, Update existing or Skip; uncertain matches are never merged automatically. Confirm the review before applying and monitor the background job.

Refresh Data quality, open each finding from its reason and remediation guidance, correct the linked record and run the check again.

Define and staff departments, offices and committees

Select the effective date. Create definitions before assignments. Departments may have a parent, primary and contribution-relevant settings. Define offices and committees, then assign members with start, optional end and regular or acting capacity. Edit dated history instead of overwriting it. Snapshot export uses the selected date.

Manage qualifications, evidence, honours and jubilees

Create a qualification type with validity and optional sport, select member and period, then upload evidence to the archive or select an existing document. Saving a file alone does not create the qualification. Record honour types and dated awards. Maintain jubilee rules and review upcoming people by date, occasion and rule; the list prepares work but does not create an award automatically.

Set up contribution accounts and plans

Create accounts and connect the member and payer, payment method, currency and SEPA basis. Build a contribution plan with code, name and validity, then rules for amount, interval, priority, criteria, proration and dates. Publish only after review. Published plans are changed through a revision; only unused drafts should be deleted.

Run billing, dunning and payment posting

For a fee run, select period, calculation date, currency and membership scope, create a preview, review items, discounts, exclusions and warnings, obtain a second approval when required, then post. Only posting creates receivables.

Configure dunning levels, preview a run, inspect blocked or excluded receivables, approve and post. When posting payments, verify amount, currency, date, reference, allocation and remaining balance; correct or remove unposted allocations.

Handle corrections, blocks, donations and accounting

Do not overwrite posted receivables. Record credit, write-off, refund, reversal or another offered adjustment with amount and reason and complete required approval. A collection or dunning block has a reason and end date and does not delete the debt.

Record monetary or in-kind donations, authorisation details and required approvals before producing a receipt; cancellation and revocation remain traceable. For accounting, complete the CSV mapping profile, preview and activate it, then create the period export. Cash-book handoff also uses a preview.

Manage SEPA master data, mandates and collections

Verify the club bank account, owner and creditor identifier. Create a mandate for the correct payer with reference, IBAN and validity, generate its form and record revocation through the dedicated action.

For collection, choose scheme and due date, create and check pre-notifications, preview the run, inspect exclusions and mandate errors, obtain approval when required, post and only then download the bank file.

Import and reconcile bank transactions

Upload supported CAMT or CSV data and review the preview, duplicates and unreadable rows before importing. Import alone does not post a payment. In reconciliation, verify suggestions, confirm clear matches or manually allocate split and combined payments, record returned debits and fees, review open items and close the day. Reopening a closed day requires the dedicated action and permission.

Use the archive, certificates, serial documents and templates

Search, open and download archive items and review type, member and status. Authorised users may upload PDF, JPEG or PNG and recover failed delivery through confirmation. Create member certificates from the relevant workflow. Qualification evidence must be uploaded and then linked to the qualification.

For serial documents, choose template, language and recipients, review missing data, start the job and check results and delivery. Maintain template type, language, content, placeholders and club design as traceable versions and check the preview.

Review statistics, saved lists and association reports

Select reporting date and movement period, then inspect membership, joins, resignations and distributions and open groups to see their members. For saved lists, choose name, status, required columns, filters and sharing; save, edit, delete or export only after checking purpose and recipients. For association reports, choose type and period, verify calculated values, complete required data and export after any required approval.

Configure modules, applications, fields, privacy and audit

Enable Members, Contributions, SEPA and Self-service in dependency order; disabling a foundation requires confirmation. Configure applications, required data and evidence, upload the current statutes and verify both reading and PDF download in the public application.

Create custom fields with type, requirement and validity; revise used definitions instead of overwriting them. Use privacy actions and full club export only for an authorised purpose. Search the audit log by period and term to identify actor, action, object and time; corrections still belong in the relevant workspace.
